prompt.en: When the child described an ordinary frustration, I paused long enough to hear their account.
prompt.zh: 孩子讲起一件日常不顺心的事时，我会停下来，给对方把情况说完的时间。

prompt.en: Before offering a solution, I checked what the child was trying to tell me.
prompt.zh: 提出解决办法前，我会先核对孩子想告诉我的是什么。

prompt.en: After saying no to a request, I kept my tone respectful.
prompt.zh: 拒绝孩子的一项请求后，我仍会保持尊重的语气。

prompt.en: I noticed and acknowledged a specific effort the child made.
prompt.zh: 我会留意并具体回应孩子作出的一项努力。

prompt.en: I offered a brief period of attention without making it depend on perfect behavior.
prompt.zh: 我会留一小段专心陪伴的时间，而不要求孩子先表现得毫无差错。

prompt.en: After a tense exchange, I returned to listen when we were both ready.
prompt.zh: 一次紧张的交流之后，双方准备好时，我会回来继续听孩子的想法。

prompt.en: I told the child what to do next in terms they could follow.
prompt.zh: 我会用孩子能理解的说法，说明接下来具体要做什么。

prompt.en: Before a routine transition, I explained the practical limit or plan.
prompt.zh: 日常活动要转换之前，我会说明实际的时间限制或安排。

prompt.en: When I set an everyday limit, I followed through on the action I had explained.
prompt.zh: 设下一项日常边界之后，我会落实先前说明过的做法。

prompt.en: When circumstances changed, I explained why an arrangement was being changed.
prompt.zh: 实际情况变化、需要调整安排时，我会解释为什么要改。

prompt.en: I made expectations fit what this child could reasonably do at that time.
prompt.zh: 我会按这个孩子当时实际能做到的情况，设定合理的要求。

prompt.en: After a plan did not work, I made the next step clear rather than adding an unrelated demand.
prompt.zh: 一项安排没有奏效后，我会说清下一步，而不是再加一项不相关的要求。

label.en: No relevant occasion / cannot judge / prefer not to answer — unscored
label.zh: 没有相关机会／无法判断／暂不回答——不计分
